raw_segments.text: Fluorizal, apprehend nothing but jollity. The gods themselves, humbling their deities
to love, have taken the shapes of beasts upon them. Jupiter became a bull in bellowed, the
green Neptune a-ram and bleated, and the fire-robbed god, Golden Apollo, a poor humble swain as
I seem now. Their transformations were never for a piece of beauty rarer, nor in a way
so chaste, since my desires run not before mine honor, nor my lusts burn hotter than
